notes.title: Gex Trilogy Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your support of Gex Trilogy, the latest patch is live now and addresses the following issues.


 Keyboard key remapping has been added to the options menu
 Addressed a startup issue for some users
 Corrected in-game audio errors for some users

Please direct any additional feedback to the Steam Support Thread. Thank you for playing Gex Trilogy!

notes.title: PAL Versions Added!
notes.content:
Thank you for making the launch of GEX Trilogy a huge success! [previewyoutube="tF8PQFvuN7Q;full"][/previewyoutube]
It’s been in the works for a while and we’re finally able to announce that the PAL versions of GEX 2 & GEX 3, featuring the iconic voices of Leslie Philips and Danny John-Jules, respectively, have been added to GEX Trilogy through an update! 

Once the update is downloaded and applied, you will be able to select the PAL versions on the menu by changing the regional flag to your preference before starting the game. Due to the fact that the NTSC and PAL versions of the game are completely separate game builds, please be aware that save data is not transferable between regional versions of the same game.

We’re excited for European GEX fans to relive these games the way they remember and for others to hear these incredible voices for the first time!

In addition to the PAL versions, we have also re-mapped the default keyboard controls for the games.

This update is being pushed live on Steam right now!
